python3 << 'EOF'
import math
import statistics

# National Defense expenditures (in millions of dollars) for fiscal years 1933-1941
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
log_growth_rates = []
years = list(expenditures.keys())
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    growth_rate = math.log(expenditures[curr_year] / expenditures[prev_year])
    log_growth_rates.append(growth_rate)
    print(f"{curr_year}: ln({expenditures[curr_year]}/{expenditures[prev_year]}) = {growth_rate:.6f}")

print("\nLog growth rates:", log_growth_rates)

# Calculate mean and standard deviation (population)
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.6f}")

# Population standard deviation (using the entire population, not sample)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population standard deviation: {std_dev:.6f}")

# Coefficient of variation = std_dev / mean
cv = std_dev / mean
print(f"\nCoefficient of variation: {cv:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(cv, 2)}")
EOF
